integrity: Analytic proof included; finite exact-arithmetic graph checks and independent literal two-dimensional row update are supporting verification only. The review is not external or independent.
scientific_limitations: The all-L theorem concerns the exact row-constant invariant sector of the three-color radius-one threshold-three Moore automaton, not arbitrary two-dimensional states. Its integer winding-sector basin sizes do not subdivide individual temporal cycles. Classical particle annihilation and general finite-cellular-automaton counting methods are acknowledged; older full-text priority coverage is incomplete.
title: Exact winding basins and complete temporal-cycle census for striped cyclic-dominance tori
